Trigger / Detection Logic: Time-based fees AND no WIP / accrued income balance
Expected State (industry norm): Unbilled time on part-performed engagements recognised as accrued income / contract asset
Query to Client: Please provide the year-end WIP/unbilled time report by client, with recoverability and expected billing.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: UITF 40 legacy principle — tax follows GAAP

Trigger / Detection Logic: Retainer or fixed-fee receipts before work
Query to Client: Please list fees received in advance of work performed at year end.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: VAT tax point on advance payment

Expected State (industry norm): Variable consideration constrained until highly probable
Query to Client: Please identify engagements with success-based fees and their status at year end.

Expected State (industry norm): Only true disbursements outside VAT; recharges standard-rated
Query to Client: Expenses recharged to clients without VAT were identified. Please confirm whether these meet the disbursement conditions.

Expected State (industry norm): B2B services generally outside scope (general rule); evidence of business status
Query to Client: Please confirm the location and business status of overseas clients.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Flat Rate Scheme AND relevant goods < 2% of turnover or < £1,000/yr
Expected State (industry norm): Limited cost trader rate applied where conditions met
Query to Client: The business uses the Flat Rate Scheme. Please confirm goods purchased to apply the limited cost business test.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Single client, single director-worker, income via day rate
Expected State (industry norm): Off-payroll status assessed (client responsibility if medium/large)
Query to Client: Please confirm the client(s), whether a status determination statement was received, and whether the client is small.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: ITEPA 2003 Part 2 Ch 8 (small clients) / Ch 10 (medium/large clients)

Trigger / Detection Logic: Client account / funds held for clients
Expected State (industry norm): Client monies not company assets; held separately
Query to Client: Please confirm whether client money is held and provide client account reconciliations.
Please confirm any claims or complaints notified to PI insurers.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Debtor days + WIP days > industry norm
Query to Client: Debtor and WIP days are high. Please confirm the recoverability of older items.
